modelscope.provenance_status: Card cites Casanueva et al. but exposes no verifiable source commit, conversion script, file inventory, manifest, or checksums in the metadata accessible to this audit.

modelscope_mteb_candidate.assessment: Stronger benchmark-maintainer provenance than modelscope/banking77 dialoglue/SPACE card, but available MTEB HF metadata describes corrected/processed v2-like data with 13,069 rows and an MIT metadata license. This is not the exact 13,083-row publisher corpus and cannot be called an exact source mirror. ModelScope-specific commit, actual files, hashes, storage sizes, and whether it mirrors this precise MTEB revision remain unknown.

modelscope_mteb_candidate.preview_handling: The MTEB HF card page rendered a public data preview when opened; no preview content is used or reproduced in this audit. No dataset payload was downloaded.

protocol_alignment.conclusion: Treat raw-source identity as aligned with the benchmark family, not as proof of exact InCA/Sleep protocol replication. Preserve the untouched official test set and explicitly freeze any derived validation/train-to-incremental-task mapping before experiments.

inca.alignment: Underlying dataset aligns. Exact reproduction is not automatic: official raw split is 10,003 train / 3,080 test, while InCA reports 10k / 1k, and this audit did not find an exact selection seed/procedure to equate those counts.
inca.public_protocol: Paper states 10k train / 1k test for Banking, seven disjoint-class tasks for the baseline CIL setup, three different task splits averaged; it also says InCA can add one class at a time.

protocol_alignment.modelscope_candidate: ModelScope card claims same 77 intents and cites same paper, but provides train/valid/test totals of 13,260 versus original 13,083 and does not explain conversion or split derivation. Not currently equivalent to the official raw split.
protocol_alignment.shared_corpus: Yes: original PolyAI Banking77, 77 intent classes, and official publisher train/test split are the relevant underlying dataset used by both InCA and Sleep papers.

sleep.alignment: Underlying corpus aligns, but split/task-protocol equivalence cannot be established from the public paper details audited.
sleep.public_protocol: Appendix B.1 describes Banking77 as 77 intents / 13,083 examples; the audited paper does not specify train/validation/test counts, class order, phase boundaries, or evaluation denominator for Banking.

protocol_alignment.validation: No native validation split. Any validation data must be declared as a derived subset of training data, with seed and stratification policy recorded.

purpose: Source and metadata audit only for prospective Banking77 comparison; no data payload was downloaded or read.
source_policy: ModelScope mteb/banking77 is the strongest hub candidate identified so far for benchmark-curated use, but its accessible linked MTEB snapshot has corrected/processed data (13,069 rows, MIT card metadata) and ModelScope revision/files remain unverified. For exact original-paper/raw-corpus fidelity, PolyAI stays canonical. The older modelscope/banking77 SPACE card (13,260 rows) has weaker provenance.
